title: Frozen forward-paper protocol for the 75/25 multi-sleeve lead

lead.signal_stream_policy: Both paper accounts consume the identical timestamped source-target stream. Scale is the only difference.

execution_policy.source_target_weights: Pairs targets are gross-normalized source weights. Calendar target is SPY exposure 0.0 or 2.5.
execution_policy.ticker_aggregation: Aggregate all source target weights by ticker before computing an order.
execution_policy.borrow_policy: No new or increased short position when borrow_available is false; covering is allowed.
execution_policy.missing_price_policy: Reject new exposure without an exact clock price. Carry an existing position at its last mark for at most one session, halt new risk while stale, and record a hard violation if still stale after one session.
execution_policy.drawdown_policy: At or below the account threshold, status becomes HALTED_DRAWDOWN and the next available clock targets zero. Resume requires an explicit new protocol; there is no automatic cooldown.

input_contract.flat_snapshot_ticker: __FLAT__ with source_target_weight 0 declares a complete empty source snapshot and requires no market row.
input_contract.causality: signal_timestamp must be no later than the market timestamp used for the simulated fill.

required: No causality, gross-cap, stale-price, borrow, or ledger-reconciliation hard violation.
Report gross and net PnL, dollar and percentage drawdown, turnover, trading cost, borrow, financing, rejected/partial fills, and concentration for both accounts.
The 1.5x account is not promoted if it hits -15% drawdown or if its return uplift does not compensate financing and execution cost.

launch_guard.approval_recorded: User explicitly approved proceeding with post-2024 data on 2026-09-24. Historical 2025-2026 remains touched implementation replay, not forward paper PnL.
